clue.text: Approach to prison is characteristic criminal storage

indicators.note: criminal suggests something bent or crooked, so the letters of storage are rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: Historic water entrance by which prisoners were taken into the Tower of London, a famous royal prison.

clue.text: A bolt, we hear? One may be sent away with it

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a sharp scolding or rebuff that sends someone off chastened.
